prior_candidates: Prism and Cloud Cargo stay terminal REJECTED; Cloud Cargo family is not classified as product failure. No cargo/airship/allocation or optical-routing reuse.

ideas.title: Ribbon Shift
ideas.mechanic: Tap a row to shift it right; tap a bottom arrow to shift a column down. Restore three scrambled 3x3 woven mosaics in45seconds. Every move displaces three tiles and later boards need intertwined row/column choices.
ideas.reason: Small exact permutation search; visible sliding/wrapping motion; one tap mechanic; no aiming/timing physics, optics or cargo. Six seeds can be independently solved with normal inputs.

ideas.title: Orbit Etcher
ideas.mechanic: Drag a brush through a scrolling contour without leaving its width, changing paths at forks.
ideas.reason: Different from selected puzzle and banned runners, but touch precision, geometric collision and comparable keyboard tracing need more commissioning complexity.

ideas.title: Echo Loom
ideas.mechanic: Watch a short geometric constellation unfurl, then tap the remembered sequence including later reversed subsequences.
ideas.reason: Different memory mechanic with stable core; later depth risks becoming only sequence length and the quiet recall phase is less visually legible in a short clip.
